faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLS 350 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. The first-generation C219 (2004–2010) uses the M272 3.5-litre petrol V6. From 2010 onwards, the C218-generation CLS 350 switched to the OM642 3.0-litre diesel V6 — a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLS 350 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: It depends on your engine code. Rebuilds for the M272 petrol V6 start from £3,200. Rebuilds for the OM642 diesel V6 start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLS 350?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M272 or the OM642 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M272 CLS 350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service this engine to the same high standard as all our other CLS rebuilds.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 CLS 350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals, and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLS 350 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLS 350 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLS 350 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLS 350 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
